cypher_query: MATCH (p:Player {player_name: $player}) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:PLAYS_AS]->(pos:Position) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:PLAYS_FOR {season: $season}]->(t:Team) RETURN p, pos, t;

description: Aggregated season stats for a player
cypher_query: MATCH (p:Player {player_name: $player})-[r:PLAYED_IN]->(f:Fixture) MATCH (f)<-[:HAS_FIXTURE]-(g:Gameweek)<-[:HAS_GW]-(s:Season {season_name: $season}) RETURN p.player_name AS player, SUM(r.total_points) AS total_points, SUM(r.goals_scored) AS goals, SUM(r.assists) AS assists, SUM(r.minutes) AS minutes, AVG(r.form) AS avg_form;

description: Player performance in a specific gameweek
cypher_query: MATCH (p:Player {player_name: $player})-[r:PLAYED_IN]->(f:Fixture) MATCH (g:Gameweek {season: $season, GW_number: $gw})-[:HAS_FIXTURE]->(f) RETURN p, r, f;

description: Home team, away team, and all player stats for a fixture
cypher_query: MATCH (f:Fixture {season: $season, fixture_number: $fixture}) MATCH (f)-[:HAS_HOME_TEAM]->(home:Team) MATCH (f)-[:HAS_AWAY_TEAM]->(away:Team) MATCH (p:Player)-[r:PLAYED_IN]->(f) RETURN f, home, away, p, r;

description: Get all fixtures where a team participated
cypher_query: MATCH (t:Team {name: $team}) MATCH (f:Fixture)-[:HAS_HOME_TEAM|HAS_AWAY_TEAM]->(t) RETURN f ORDER BY f.kickoff_time;

description: All players who play for a specific team in a season
Top N players in a position in a season
cypher_query: MATCH (p:Player)-[:PLAYS_AS]->(:Position {name: $position}) MATCH (p)-[r:PLAYED_IN]->(f:Fixture) MATCH (f)<-[:HAS_FIXTURE]-(g:Gameweek)<-[:HAS_GW]-(s:Season {season_name: $season}) RETURN p.player_name AS player, SUM(r.total_points) AS points ORDER BY points DESC LIMIT $limit;

description: Compare total points between two players
cypher_query: MATCH (p1:Player {player_name: $player1})-[r1:PLAYED_IN]->(f1:Fixture) MATCH (p2:Player {player_name: $player2})-[r2:PLAYED_IN]->(f2:Fixture) RETURN p1.player_name AS player1, SUM(r1.total_points) AS p1_points, p2.player_name AS player2, SUM(r2.total_points) AS p2_points;

description: Retrieve all fixtures and stats for a gameweek
cypher_query: MATCH (g:Gameweek {season: $season, GW_number: $gw})-[:HAS_FIXTURE]->(f) MATCH (p:Player)-[r:PLAYED_IN]->(f) RETURN g, f, p, r ORDER BY f.fixture_number;

description: Player performance against a specific opponent
cypher_query: MATCH (p:Player {player_name: $player})-[r:PLAYED_IN]->(f:Fixture) MATCH (p)-[:PLAYED_AGAINST]->(opp:Team {name: $opponent}) RETURN p.player_name AS player, opp.name AS opponent, SUM(r.goals_scored) AS goals, SUM(r.assists) AS assists, SUM(r.total_points) AS points;
